overview: CDE proposes curiosity-driven exploration for RLVR by leveraging actor perplexity bonus and multi-head critic variance bonus to address premature convergence and calibration collapse in LLM reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Loading
modules.description: Processes the DAPO-17K training dataset and evaluation benchmarks (MATH, AMC23, AIME24, AIME25), including filtering non-numeric answer problems from MATH-500, formatting prompts with the step-by-step instruction template, tokenization, and constructing a custom Dataset/DataLoader with batch sampling for rollout generation.

modules.name: GRPO Policy Core
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm: generates a group of G candidate responses per prompt, computes group-relative advantages via mean/std normalization of verifiable rewards, and performs the clipped surrogate objective update with token-level probability ratios.

modules.name: PPO with Single-head Critic
modules.description: Implements standard PPO with a learned value function, computing GAE-based advantages using temporal difference residuals with discount factor and trace-decay parameter, and performing the clipped surrogate policy update. The critic is trained via mean-squared error on value targets.

modules.name: PPL Bonus Computation
modules.description: Computes the actor curiosity signal as the negative average log-probability of the generated response tokens under the current policy, yielding a response-level perplexity-based bonus that measures the model's surprise at its own generation.

modules.name: Adaptive Reward Clipping Mechanism
modules.description: Implements the clipped bonus combination that integrates the curiosity bonus with the original reward: the total reward is the original reward plus the bonus clipped by a fraction of the absolute original reward, controlled by clipping ratio κ, bonus scaling factor α, and dynamic bonus weight ω. This prevents the bonus from dominating the learning signal.

modules.name: Bonus Weight Decay Scheduling
modules.description: Provides multiple annealing schedules for the bonus weight ω including No decay, Linear decay, Cosine decay, and Staircase decay. The Staircase schedule sustains high exploration early then removes the bonus abruptly to allow stable convergence.

modules.name: Multi-head Critic Architecture
modules.description: Extends the single-head critic to K heads sharing a common LLM backbone with separate final classification layers. Each head outputs an independent value estimate, and the architecture change corresponds to modifying the output dimension of the value head from 1 to K.

modules.name: Bootstrap Critic Training
modules.description: Trains each critic head on a resampled subset of collected trajectories sampled with replacement, where the subset size is controlled by sub-sample fraction ζ. Each head minimizes mean-squared error on its own bootstrap sample, creating an ensemble approximation to the posterior distribution of value estimates.

modules.name: Critic Variance Bonus
modules.description: Computes the critic curiosity signal as the standard deviation across the K value heads' estimates for a given state, providing an exploration bonus that targets regions where the critics disagree (high uncertainty). This bonus is integrated into the advantage computation using the same adaptive clipping mechanism as the PPL bonus.

modules.name: Multi-head PPO Advantage Computation
modules.description: Computes PPO advantages using the ensemble of K value heads: the TD residual uses the average of K value estimates, and the advantage combines the modified GAE estimate with the clipped critic variance bonus. This unifies the critic-based exploration signal into the standard PPO advantage framework.

modules.name: GRPO with PPL Bonus Training Pipeline
modules.description: End-to-end training loop for GRPO augmented with the PPL bonus: generates rollouts, computes verifiable rewards, calculates PPL bonuses, applies adaptive clipping to form shaped rewards, computes group-relative advantages with shaped rewards, and performs the GRPO policy update with bonus weight decay scheduling.

modules.name: Multi-head PPO Training Pipeline
modules.description: End-to-end training loop for PPO with the multi-head critic: generates rollouts with the actor, computes advantages using multi-head critic variance bonus and ensemble TD residuals, updates the actor with the clipped surrogate objective, and updates each critic head on its bootstrap sample.

modules.name: Hash-based Pseudo-count Baseline
modules.description: Implements the SimHash-based count exploration baseline: projects the last token's hidden state through a random projection matrix to generate a k-bit hash code, maps it to a bucket index, tracks visitation counts, and shapes the reward with a bonus inversely proportional to the square root of the visitation count.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics and Benchmark Runner
modules.description: Computes all evaluation metrics: Avg@1 (single response accuracy for MATH), Avg@16 and Pass@16 (from 16 independent samples at temperature 1.0 for AMC23, AIME24, AIME25), and the overall average score. Runs zero-shot evaluation across all four benchmarks and supports both Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct models.

modules.name: Calibration and Entropy Dynamics Analysis
modules.description: Tracks and visualizes calibration collapse by recording average response PPL stratified by correctness at each training step, detecting whether the gap between correct and incorrect PPL shrinks over training. Also monitors policy entropy dynamics over training to detect entropy collapse and assess the effect of different bonus weight decay schedules on exploration stability.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Systematic ablation framework supporting: (1) bonus weight decay schedule comparison (No decay, Linear, Cosine, Staircase), (2) sensitivity analysis on clipping ratio κ and scaling factor α for both PPL and critic bonuses, (3) ablation on sub-sample fraction ζ across different head counts, (4) comparison with entropy bonus and i-MENTOR baselines, (5) multi-head head count scaling analysis (K=2,4,8,16), and (6) cross-dataset analysis of critic disagreement dynamics on training vs. in-domain vs. out-of-domain data.
